To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
deep learning techniques are effective in fine-grained image recognition, and the deep learning based methods can also achieve impressive performance in fine-grained semantic segmentation.
the deep learning based finegrained classification approaches can be classified into four types: general CNNs, part detection based, ensembles based and visual attention.

(i) deep learning based finegrained image classification approaches are able to achieve promising results by exploiting the high-level semantic information; and (ii) deep learning based semantic seg-mentation approaches are able to obtain impressive results by exploiting the low-level pixel-level information.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the recent advances of deep neural networks for fine-grained image recognition.
the deep learning based methods for fine-grained image recognition and semantic segmentation.
the recent advances of deep convolutional neural networks and their application to fine-grained object recognition and semantic segmentation tasks.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
deep learning approaches have been successfully applied to the fine-grained image categorization and semantic segmentation tasks, and the future research directions would be discussed in this survey.
deep learning based fine grained image classification approaches are promising and have shown encouraging results.
deep learning approaches can achieve promising results in fine-grained image recognition and semantic segmentation tasks.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the general CNNs based fine-grained classification approaches are the most effective and popular approaches.
the deep learning based fine grained image classification and semantic segmentation approaches are promising.
the deep learning based methods are able to achieve state-of-the-art performance on both the fine-grained image categorization task and the semantic segmentation task.

, the deep learning approaches can achieve promising performance on the fine-grained image understanding tasks.
